finalMessage:
I moved `Tax` to `pricing/salestax.go` and renamed it `SalesTax`. Build, vet, gofmt and all tests pass, and `ostf check --base main` exits 0.

**Changes**
- `pricing/salestax.go` (new): `SalesTax`, same body and doc comment as before.
- `pricing/tax.go`: keeps only `Region`.
- `pricing/quote.go`: `Price` calls `SalesTax`.
- `pricing/tax_test.go`: call sites and the error message now use `SalesTax`. I kept the test names `TestTax` and `TestTaxExempt` because `trace/requirements.yaml` and the `@req R-TAX-EXEMPT` comment refer to them.
- `trace/requirements.yaml`: the `code:` links on R-TAX-RATE and R-TAX-EXEMPT now point to `pricing/salestax.go#SalesTax`. I changed only the link paths, not the item text.

**Trace items**
- **R-TAX-RATE** (sales tax on the post-discount subtotal, rounded half up): still true. Its code link was updated. Tests: `pricing/tax_test.go#TestTax`, `pricing/tax_test.go#TestPrice`.
- **R-TAX-EXEMPT** (exempt customers pay no tax): still true. Its code link was updated. Test: `pricing/tax_test.go#TestTaxExempt`.
- **D-RATES-PPM** links `pricing/tax.go#Region`, which did not move, so it is unaffected.

None of the touched items is risk-relevant (no `controls:` link to a RISK item), so nothing needs a risk-review flag. The check's two existing warnings about R-ORDER-NOTE and R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT having no links were there before my change.

**Not updated:** `trace.derived` still names `pricing/tax.go#Tax`. It is a generated file, and I found no command in this environment to regenerate it, so it will be stale until someone regenerates it.
